passages.text: Now the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. These were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. They approached the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders, and the whole congregation, and said, “Our father died in the wilderness, but he was not among the followers of Korah who gathered together against the LORD. Instead, he died because of his own sin, and he had no sons.
passages.sermon:
Zelophehad was the son of Hepher.
Hepher was the son of Gilead.
Gilead was the son of Machir.
Machir was the son of Manasseh.
Manasseh was the son of Joseph.
Zelophehad belonged to the clans of Manasseh, son of Joseph.
Zelophehad had daughters.
The names of his daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
These daughters came forward.
They approached the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
They stood before Moses.
They stood before Eleazar the priest.
They stood before the leaders.
They stood before the whole congregation.
They spoke to them.
They said, “Our father died in the wilderness.
He was not among those who gathered against the LORD with Korah’s assembly.
He died because of his own sin.
He had no sons.”
passages.original: וַתִּקְרַ֜בְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֗ד בֶּן־ חֵ֤פֶר בֶּן־ גִּלְעָד֙ בֶּן־ מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן־ יוֹסֵ֑ף וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֹתָ֔יו מַחְלָ֣ה נֹעָ֔ה וְחָגְלָ֥ה וּמִלְכָּ֖ה וְתִרְצָֽה׃ וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֜דְנָה לִפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְלִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הַנְּשִׂיאִ֖ם וְכָל־ הָעֵדָ֑ה פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד לֵאמֹֽר׃ אָבִינוּ֮ מֵ֣ת בַּמִּדְבָּר֒ וְה֨וּא לֹא־ הָיָ֜ה בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעֵדָ֗ה הַנּוֹעָדִ֛ים עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה בַּעֲדַת־ קֹ֑רַח כִּֽי־ בְחֶטְא֣וֹ מֵ֔ת וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־ הָ֥יוּ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan because he had no sons? Give us property among our father’s brothers.”
passages.sermon:
The daughters of Zelophehad spoke to Moses and the leaders.
Their father had died in the wilderness.
He had no sons.
They belonged to the tribe of Manasseh, son of Joseph.
They said, “Our father’s name should not disappear from his clan.
He has no son to carry on his name.
Give us property among our father’s brothers.”
passages.original: לָ֣מָּה יִגָּרַ֤ע שֵׁם־ אָבִ֙ינוּ֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֔וֹ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ בֵּ֑ן תְּנָה־ לָּ֣נוּ אֲחֻזָּ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֥י אָבִֽינוּ׃

passages.text: So Moses brought their case before the LORD, and the LORD answered him, “The daughters of Zelophehad speak correctly. You certainly must give them property as an inheritance among their father’s brothers, and transfer their father’s inheritance to them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The daughters of Zelophehad came to Moses with a request.
Moses brought their case before the LORD.
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said the daughters of Zelophehad are right.
The LORD commanded Moses to give them property as an inheritance.
The property must be among their father’s brothers.
Moses must transfer their father’s inheritance to them.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֥ב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטָ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ כֵּ֗ן בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָד֮ דֹּבְרֹת֒ נָתֹ֨ן תִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֣י אֲבִיהֶ֑ם וְהַֽעֲבַרְתָּ֛ אֶת־ נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבִיהֶ֖ן לָהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Furthermore, you shall say to the Israelites, ‘If a man dies and leaves no son, you are to transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses a law for the Israelites.
God said, “Speak to the Israelites.”
God said, “If a man dies and has no son, do this.”
Transfer the man’s inheritance to his daughter.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ כִּֽי־ יָמ֗וּת וּבֵן֙ אֵ֣ין ל֔וֹ וְהַֽעֲבַרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לְבִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.
passages.sermon:
A man in Israel may die.
He may have no daughter.
If he has no daughter, you must give his inheritance to his brothers.
passages.original: וְאִם־ אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ בַּ֑ת וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לְאֶחָיו׃

passages.text: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
passages.sermon: The law concerns inheritance among the Israelites.\r\nIf a man dies and has no brothers, act as follows.\r\nGive his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
passages.original: וְאִם־ אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ אַחִ֑ים וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לַאֲחֵ֥י אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: And if his father has no brothers, give his inheritance to the next of kin from his clan, that he may take possession of it. This is to be a statutory ordinance for the Israelites, as the LORD has commanded Moses.’ ”
passages.sermon:
If a man dies and his father has no brothers, give the man's inheritance to his closest relative from his clan.
That relative will take possession of the inheritance.
This rule is a law for the Israelites.
The LORD commanded Moses to give this law.
passages.original: וְאִם־ אֵ֣ין אַחִים֮ לְאָבִיו֒ וּנְתַתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֗וֹ לִשְׁאֵר֞וֹ הַקָּרֹ֥ב אֵלָ֛יו מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ וְיָרַ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑הּ וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה לִבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְחֻקַּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֔ט כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go up this mountain of the Abarim range and see the land that I have given the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said, “Go up this mountain.
This mountain is in the Abarim range.
Look at the land from there.
I have given this land to the Israelites.
See the land I have given them.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה עֲלֵ֛ה אֶל־ הַ֥ר הָעֲבָרִ֖ים הַזֶּ֑ה וּרְאֵה֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was; for when the congregation contended in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you rebelled against My command to show My holiness in their sight regarding the waters.” Those were the waters of Meribah in Kadesh, in the Wilderness of Zin.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to look at the land.
God had given this land to the Israelites.
God said, “After you see the land, you will die and join your ancestors.”
Aaron was Moses’ brother.
Aaron had already died and joined his ancestors.
God explained why Moses would die before entering the land.
God said, “You and Aaron disobeyed Me.”
This happened when the people argued in the Wilderness of Zin.
God had commanded Moses and Aaron to show His holiness to the people.
They did not obey God’s command about the water.
This event happened at the waters of Meribah.
Meribah was in Kadesh, in the Wilderness of Zin.
passages.original: וְרָאִ֣יתָה אֹתָ֔הּ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ֥ אֶל־ עַמֶּ֖יךָ גַּם־ אָ֑תָּה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶאֱסַ֖ף אַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִֽיךָ׃ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ מְרִיתֶ֨ם פִּ֜י בְּמִדְבַּר־ צִ֗ן בִּמְרִיבַת֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה לְהַקְדִּישֵׁ֥נִי בַמַּ֖יִם לְעֵינֵיהֶ֑ם הֵ֛ם מֵֽי־ מְרִיבַ֥ת קָדֵ֖שׁ מִדְבַּר־ צִֽן׃פ

passages.text: So Moses appealed to the LORD, “May the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation who will go out and come in before them, and who will lead them out and bring them in, so that the congregation of the LORD will not be like sheep without a shepherd.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the LORD.
Moses prayed to the LORD.
The LORD is the God of the spirits of all flesh.
Moses asked the LORD to appoint a man over the congregation.
This man will go out before the people.
This man will come in before the people.
This man will lead the people out.
This man will bring the people in.
Moses did not want the congregation of the LORD to be like sheep without a shepherd.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ יִפְקֹ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָרוּחֹ֖ת לְכָל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר אִ֖ישׁ עַל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃ אֲשֶׁר־ יֵצֵ֣א לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יָבֹא֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹצִיאֵ֖ם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יְבִיאֵ֑ם וְלֹ֤א תִהְיֶה֙ עֲדַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כַּצֹּ֕אן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין־ לָהֶ֖ם רֹעֶֽה׃

passages.text: And the LORD replied to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man with the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, "Take Joshua son of Nun."
Joshua is a man.
Joshua has the Spirit in him.
Lay your hand on Joshua.
Place your hand on him.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה קַח־ לְךָ֙ אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֔וּן אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ ר֣וּחַ בּ֑וֹ וְסָמַכְתָּ֥ אֶת־ יָדְךָ֖ עָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation, and commission him in their sight.
passages.sermon:
Joshua is the man God chose.
Joshua must stand before Eleazar the priest.
Joshua must also stand before the whole congregation.
You must commission Joshua.
You must do this in the sight of all the people.
passages.original: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֗וֹ לִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֑ה וְצִוִּיתָ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Confer on him some of your authority, so that the whole congregation of Israel will obey him.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to give Joshua some of his authority.
Joshua is the son of Nun.
Joshua has the Spirit in him.
Moses must place his authority on Joshua.
This will cause all the people of Israel to obey Joshua.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֥ה מֵהֽוֹדְךָ֖ עָלָ֑יו לְמַ֣עַן יִשְׁמְע֔וּ כָּל־ עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who will seek counsel for him before the LORD by the judgment of the Urim. At his command, he and all the Israelites with him—the entire congregation—will go out and come in.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua will stand before Eleazar the priest.
Eleazar is the high priest.
Eleazar will seek guidance for Joshua from the LORD.
Eleazar will use the judgment of the Urim to ask the LORD.
Joshua will act according to Eleazar’s command.
All the Israelites will follow Joshua’s command.
The entire congregation will go out and come in at Joshua’s word.
passages.original: וְלִפְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְשָׁ֥אַל ל֛וֹ בְּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט הָאוּרִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ פִּ֨יו יֵצְא֜וּ וְעַל־ פִּ֣יו יָבֹ֗אוּ ה֛וּא וְכָל־ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אִתּ֖וֹ וְכָל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃

passages.text: Moses did as the LORD had commanded him. He took Joshua, had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation, and laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD had instructed through Moses.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
Moses obeyed the LORD.
Moses took Joshua.
Joshua was the chosen successor.
Moses brought Joshua before Eleazar the priest.
Moses brought Joshua before the whole congregation of Israel.
Moses laid his hands on Joshua.
Moses commissioned Joshua.
Moses did everything as the LORD had instructed through him.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיַּֽעֲמִדֵ֙הוּ֙ לִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃ וַיִּסְמֹ֧ךְ אֶת־ יָדָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו וַיְצַוֵּ֑הוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
